purpose: Separate final external identity confirmation from independent stress tests and consumed development resources. Counts are never interchangeable.

denominator_contract.N_Q: labelled query spectra retained after all exclusions
denominator_contract.N_I: unique labelled identity clusters represented by the queries
denominator_contract.N_F: unique molecular-formula clusters represented by the queries
denominator_contract.N_P: actual query-reference-spectrum comparisons used to construct candidate scores
denominator_contract.prohibited_claim: N_P must never be reported as the number of labelled queries

primary_external_candidates.selection_rule: Use only NIST26 identities/spectra genuinely new relative to NIST23, then exclude every consumed training/development identity, formula and available exact spectrum hash.
Use only accessions and identities first released after the method freeze date and remove overlap with all consumed sources.
Independent laboratory, blinded identities, multiple instruments and collision energies, frozen candidate construction before unblinding.

independent_stress_sources.primary_condition: CID 60 eV query to CID 40 eV reference
independent_stress_sources.secondary_condition: EAD 16 eV query to CID 40 eV reference
independent_stress_sources.claim_boundary: Independent focused OOD/cross-condition confirmation only; expected competitive-query denominator is hundreds, not a sole SOTA benchmark.

large_open_aggregations.truth_boundary: The billion-scale values are public raw spectra and FASST-predicted matches, not independent authentic-standard identity labels. Aggregated reference labels and repeated source spectra require identity, source and exact-spectrum de-duplication. This is not automatically an independent final test.

large_open_aggregations.access_boundary: The searchable web resource is public-facing, but the bulk local database is separately licensed/commercial and was not verified as an open download.

consumed_or_contaminated_sources.truth_boundary: The snapshot mixes standards, propagated annotations, MassQL-derived, multiplex and imported libraries; counts are not a uniform gold-standard label set.
MoNA download categories overlap and must not be summed. The aggregate mixes sources and has been used by several comparator models.
